notes: Identity verified from supplied text: title Training in cognitive strategies reduces eating and improves food choice; authors Rebecca G Boswell, Wendy Sun, Shosuke Suzuki, Hedy Kober; DOI 10.1073/pnas.1717092115; PNAS 2018, 115(48), E11238–E11247. This is a full primary-article PMC parse with Results, Methods, Discussion and references, not just an abstract. Supplementary PDF is linked by name but its contents are not supplied; source_pdf_path is null, so no PDF rendering is possible. Study 6 is identified, but the neutral description covers the entire six-study paper and p.12 has no resolvable page marker in this unpaginated text. No specific Study 6 contrast/outcome/test is identified. Candidate tests on healthy choices include Time F(1,435)=37.93, P<0.001; Time × Condition F(4,435)=9.20, P<0.001; Condition P=0.29; baseline between-condition P=0.67; POSITIVE versus NEGATIVE ROC-T P=0.87; positive-framing pre/post P=0.14; negative-framing pre/post t(76)=2.01, P=0.05; comparison between framing conditions P=0.55. Direct ROC-T versus framing pairwise comparisons are described narratively with referral to SI Results. Other Study 6 outcomes include reaction times, training generalization and BMI correlations. No candidate is selected by numeric matching or assumed target priority.
